meta.name: Detect and email top job matches with RemoteOK, Arbeitnow, OpenAI, Gmail and PostgreSQL

parameters.content:
## Job Data Ingestion Pipeline

This section is responsible for continuously fetching fresh job listings from multiple external APIs. It runs every 2 hours and ensures a constant inflow of opportunities from RemoteOK and Arbeitnow. This forms the foundation of the system’s real-time job intelligence pipeline.

## Job Data Normalization Layer

This section standardizes raw job data from different APIs into a unified structure. It ensures all jobs follow consistent fields like title, company, description, skills, and apply links. Merging both sources enables unified downstream processing and eliminates API-specific inconsistencies.

## Skill Extraction & Enrichment Engine

This section intelligently extracts missing skills from job descriptions using keyword mapping. It enriches incomplete job postings by detecting relevant technologies and frameworks. This improves job quality for matching and ensures even poorly structured listings remain usable.

return items.map(item => {
  const job = item.json;

  if (!job.skills || job.skills.length === 0) {
    const text = (job.title + " " + job.description).toLowerCase();

    job.skills = [];

    for (const [skill, aliases] of Object.entries(SKILL_MAP)) {
      if (aliases.some(a => new RegExp(`\\b${a}\\b`).test(text))) {
        job.skills.push(skill);
      }
    }
  }

  return { json: job };
});

parameters.query: SELECT job_hash FROM opportunities WHERE job_hash = '{{ $json.job_hash }}';

INSERT INTO opportunities (
  job_hash,
  title,
  company,
  description,
  location,
  skills,
  salary,
  source,
  created_at,
  quality_score,
  apply_url
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.job_hash }}',
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.company.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.description.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.location.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.skills || []).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.salary || null }}',
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.source }}',
  NOW(),
  {{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.quality_score }},
  '{{ $('Iterate Jobs for Insert').item.json.apply_url }}'
)
ON CONFLICT (job_hash) DO NOTHING;

SELECT id, name, skills, preferred_location, experience_years
FROM users;

SELECT job_hash, title, company, description, location, skills, quality_score
FROM opportunities
WHERE quality_score >= 30
AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '14 days';

INSERT INTO matches (
  user_id,
  job_id,
  fit_score,
  skill_score,
  quality_score,
  notified
)
VALUES (
  {{ $json.user_id }},
  '{{ $json.job_id }}',
  {{ $json.fit_score }},
  {{ $json.skill_score }},
  {{ $json.quality_score }},
  false
)
ON CONFLICT (user_id, job_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  fit_score = EXCLUDED.fit_score,
  skill_score = EXCLUDED.skill_score,
  quality_score = EXCLUDED.quality_score;

SELECT DISTINCT user_id
FROM matches
WHERE fit_score >= 60
AND notified = false;

SELECT 
  m.job_id,
  m.fit_score,
  j.title,
  j.company,
  j.location,
  j.apply_url
FROM matches m
JOIN opportunities j ON j.job_hash = m.job_id
WHERE m.user_id = {{$json.id}}
AND m.fit_score >= 60
AND m.notified = false
ORDER BY m.fit_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

parameters.subject: Top Opportunities

parameters.content:
## Job Scoring & Deduplication Engine

This section assigns a quality score to each job based on completeness, clarity, and relevance. It also generates a unique hash for deduplication, ensuring no duplicate job entries enter the system. Only high-value, structured jobs move forward.

## Job Storage Pipeline
This section handles safe storage of job data into the database. Each job is checked against existing records using a unique hash. Only new jobs are inserted, preventing duplication and ensuring clean, structured job storage in PostgreSQL.

## Matching Engine – Data Preparation

This section prepares datasets for matching by loading active users and recent high-quality jobs. It creates user-job combinations so that every user is evaluated against relevant opportunities. This forms the input dataset for the scoring engine.

## Matching Intelligence Engine

This section calculates personalized fit scores based on skills, location, experience, and job quality. It filters weak matches and keeps only high-quality recommendations. Final results are stored in the database for notification processing.

## Notification Preparation Layer

This section gathers all unnotified high-quality matches and organizes them per user. It fetches user details and selects top job recommendations. It ensures only meaningful job sets proceed to AI summarization and email generation.

## AI Email Generation Layer

This section uses AI to generate a concise and actionable summary of job recommendations. It transforms structured job data into a user-friendly message, highlighting best opportunities and next steps for the user.

## Email Delivery & Notification Update

This section sends personalized job emails to users via Gmail. After successful delivery, it updates the database to mark matches as notified. This prevents duplicate alerts and maintains notification consistency.

## Workflow Overview & Setup Guide

This workflow is a fully automated Job Opportunity Detection Engine built in n8n. It continuously fetches job listings from multiple APIs every 2 hours, normalizes and enriches the data with extracted skills and quality scoring, and stores only unique high-quality jobs in a PostgreSQL database.

Every 6 hours, the matching engine evaluates user profiles against available jobs using a weighted scoring system based on skills, location, experience, and job quality. Only strong matches are stored and later processed for notifications.

Another scheduled workflow collects unnotified matches, groups them per user, and prepares personalized job recommendations. An AI model generates a concise summary of job opportunities, which is then formatted into an HTML email and sent via Gmail.

Finally, the system marks notified matches to prevent duplication.

**Setup Steps:**

**1.** Configure API endpoints for RemoteOK and Arbeitnow.
**2.** Set up PostgreSQL tables for users, jobs, and matches.
**3.** Connect OpenAI and Gmail credentials in n8n.
**4.** Ensure all triggers are enabled (2h + 6h schedules).
**5.** Validate database schema for job_hash and match constraints.
